Load libraries
```{r}
library(CellTFusion)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
source("src/utils.R")
set.seed(123)
```

Load data
```{r}
# Megaclusters data
entropy_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Spatial_cluster != "cDC1+") 
density_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")

# DC densities data
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")

### Replace '+' with 'plus' to avoid mismatches and change to a numeric matrix
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- gsub("\\+", "_plus", colnames(x))
  x <- as.matrix(x)                     
  storage.mode(x) <- "numeric"       
  return(x)
})

# Bulk RNAseq and clinical data
counts = read.csv("../input/raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) ## 116 patients in total
coldata = read.csv("../input/raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("N_Raw_matrice_Bulk")

counts = counts[,rownames(coldata)] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data

all.equal(rownames(coldata), colnames(counts)) #Verify samples from counts are in the correct order
```

Match samples with spatial and RNAseq (60 patients)
```{r}
# Entropy matrix
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

# Density matrix
df_density = density_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Cluster_type, Nombre_cluster_type_mm2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster_type,
    values_from = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

coldata = coldata[rownames(coldata)%in%rownames(df_entropy),]
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(coldata)]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy) %in% colnames(counts),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density) %in% colnames(counts),]

df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(coldata),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(coldata),]

all.equal(rownames(df_entropy), colnames(counts))
all.equal(rownames(df_density), colnames(counts))

#Spatial data
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(df) {
  df <- df[rownames(df) %in% coldata$AN_clean, ]
  df = df[coldata$AN_clean,] #Order samples
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  df <- df %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Samples = rownames(coldata)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Samples")
  return(df)
})

all.equal(rownames(data_spatial[[1]]), rownames(coldata)) #Verify samples from clinical match the order from spatial
all.equal(rownames(data_spatial[[1]]), colnames(counts)) #Verify samples from counts match the order from spatial
```

Normalize counts (60 patients)
```{r}
counts.TPM.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
counts.norm.log = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

DCs-markers expression vs cell densities (60 patients)
```{r}
dc_subtypes = c("cDC1_plus", "cDC2_plus", "Mature_DC_plus", "pDC_plus")
data_spatial = do.call(cbind, data_spatial)

# Create gene set list
gene_sets <- list(
  Signature_cDC1_plus = c("CLNK", "XCR1", "WDFY4", "CLEC9A", "DNASE1L3"),
  Signature_cDC2_plus = c("CLEC10A", "CD1C", "FCER1A"),
  Signature_Mature_DC_plus = c("LAMP3", "BIRC3", "CCR7"),
  Signature_pDC_plus = c("CLEC4C",  "LILRA4", "PACSIN1", "SPIB")
)

markers_all = unlist(unname(gene_sets))

# Calulate DCs signature scores
dc_signatures_score = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, gene_sets = gene_sets)[[2]]

## DC signatures - DC densities
compute.modules.relationship(dc_signatures_score, data_spatial[,grep(paste0(paste0("Total.", dc_subtypes), collapse = "|"), 
                                                                     colnames(data_spatial)), drop = F], 
                             file_name = "DC_signatures-densities", width = 8, height = 7)

## Markers expression - DC densities
compute.modules.relationship(data_spatial[,grep(paste0(paste0("Total.", dc_subtypes), collapse = "|"), 
                                                colnames(data_spatial)), drop = F], 
                             t(counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%markers_all,]),
                             file_name = "DC_markers-densities", width = 10, height = 7)

## DC signatures from RNAseq across response
compute.metadata.association(dc_signatures_score, coldata[,"R.NR",drop=F], file.name = "DC_signatures_Response", width = 8, height = 15, pval = 1)
```

Analysis across patient clusters 
```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

Add patient groups obtained from megaclusters densities (58 patients) --> Remember there were 2 outliers
```{r}
load("../output/Patients_groups.RData")
patient_groups = patient_groups[rownames(patient_groups)%in%coldata$AN,]
coldata = coldata[coldata$AN%in%rownames(patient_groups),]
patient_groups = patient_groups[coldata$AN,]
all.equal(rownames(patient_groups), coldata$AN) ## Rownames of coldata and patient_groups are in AN
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = factor(ifelse(patient_groups$Groups == 4, 3, patient_groups$Groups))) ## Rename group 
table(coldata$Groups)
```

Match patients in groups from spatial with RNAseq bulk (58 patients)
```{r}
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(coldata)]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy)%in%rownames(coldata),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density)%in%rownames(coldata),]
```

Normalize counts (58 patients)
```{r}
counts.TPM.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
counts.norm.log = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

TF analysis (58 patients)
```{r}
tfs = compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log)
#network = compute.WTCNA(tfs, corr_mod = 0.8, clustering.method = "ward.D2", return = T) 

#### Create TF network 
tfs_modules = read.csv("Results/TFs_modules.csv")

tfs_list <- setNames(
  strsplit(tfs_modules$Composition, ","),
  tfs_modules$TFs.module
)

tf_to_color <- unlist(lapply(names(tfs_list), function(color) {
  setNames(rep(color, length(tfs_list[[color]])), trimws(tfs_list[[color]]))
}))

tf_colors <- unname(tf_to_color[colnames(tfs)])

MEList = WGCNA::moduleEigengenes(tfs, colors = tf_colors, scale = F)
MEs = MEList$eigengenes
MEs = WGCNA::orderMEs(MEs)
colnames(MEs) <- gsub("ME", "", colnames(MEs))

network = list()
network[["TFs module matrix"]] = MEs
network[["TFs colors"]] = tf_colors
network[["TFs per module"]] = tf_to_color

#### TF modules - patient clusters
compute.metadata.association(network[[1]], coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 5, file.name = "TF_modules_Groups")

#### TF modules - megaclusters density and entropy
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], df_entropy, "Entropy-TFs_Modules", width = 8)
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], df_density, "Density-TFs_Modules", width = 8)
```

Pathway analysis (58 patients)
```{r}
pathways = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log)
#TF modules - pathways
compute.modules.relationship(network[[1]], pathways, "Pathways_Progeny-TFs_Modules", width = 10)
```

Chemokines scores (58 patients)
```{r}
chemokines = c("CCL1", "CCL11", "CCL13", "CCL16", "CCL17", "CCL19", "CCL2", "CCL20", "CCL21", "CCL22", "CCL23", "CCL24","CCL25", 
               "CCL26", "CCL27", "CCL4", "CCL7", "CCL8", "CX3CL1", "CXCL1","CXCL11", "CXCL12", "CXCL16", "CXCL3", "CXCL5", "CXCL6", 
               "PPBP", "XCL1", "XCL2", "ACKR4", "CCR1", "CCR10", "CCR2", "CCR3", "CCR4", "CCR6", "CCR7", "CCR8", "CCR9",
               "CMKLR1", "CXCR1", "CXCR3", "CXCR4", "CXCR6", "DARC", "XCR1")

geneset = list(chemokines)

chemokines_score = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, gene_sets = geneset)[[2]]
colnames(chemokines_score)[[1]] = "chemokines_score"

counts.norm.chemokines = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%chemokines,]

#### Chemokines - megaclusters density and entropy
compute.modules.relationship(t(counts.norm.chemokines), df_entropy, "Entropy-Chemokines", width = 8, height = 15)
compute.modules.relationship(t(counts.norm.chemokines), df_density, "Density-Chemokines", width = 8, height = 15)

#### Chemokines signatures - Patient groups
compute.metadata.association(chemokines_score, coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 1, file.name = "Chemokines_signature_Groups")

#### Chemokines - Patient groups
compute.metadata.association(t(counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%chemokines,]), 
                             coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 1, file.name = "Chemokines_Groups")
```

Cell type deconvolution (58 patients)

#Filter to only patients within clusters
deconv = deconv[rownames(deconv)%in%rownames(coldata),]

# Filter to only LM22 signature
deconv_cbsx_lm22 = deconv[,grep("CBSX_LM22", colnames(deconv))] 

### Deconvolution - Patients groups
compute.metadata.association(deconv_cbsx_lm22, coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 1, file.name = "Deconvolution_Groups")

### Deconvolution - Megaclusters density
compute.modules.relationship(deconv_cbsx_lm22, df_density, "Density-Deconv_LM22", width = 8, height = 12)

compute.modules.relationship(deconv_cbsx_lm22, df_entropy, "Entropy-Deconv_LM22", width = 8, height = 12)

Differential active TFs across patient groups (58 patients)
```{r}
library(viper)
coldata$group_1 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 1, 1, "rest"))
res_1 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_1, "1", "rest", file.name = "Diff_1vsrest")

coldata$group_2 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 2, 2, "rest"))
res_2 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_2, "2", "rest", file.name = "Diff_2vsrest")

coldata$group_3 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 3, 3, "rest"))
res_3 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_3, "3", "rest", file.name = "Diff_3vsrest")

gene_sets <- list(
  Group1_markers = res_1$TFs_UP,
  Group2_markers = res_2$TFs_UP,
  Group3_markers = res_3$TFs_UP
)
```

TFs signatures scores (58 patients)
```{r}
tfs = scale(compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log))
deg_signatures_score = compute.pathway.activity(t(tfs), gene_sets = gene_sets)[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(deg_signatures_score, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
coldata$deg_group = patient_group
```

Survival analysis (58 patients)
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(coldata, "PFS", "PFS_event", file_name = "Patient_groups", p.value = 0.05, group_column = "deg_group")
```
